newsitem.title: USA: Stocks rattled by earnings warnings.
newsitem.headline: Stocks rattled by earnings warnings.

text.p: Stocks closed lower Wednesday after warnings about profits from high technology companies cooled some of the optimism about corporate earnings for the latest quarter.

Based on early and unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 42.07 points at 7,718.71. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 12-11 on active volume of 495 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
